verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK provides the same agent loop, built-in tools (file read/write, shell commands, web search), subagents, and session persistence that power Claude Code, letting a user delegate multi-step tasks to Claude and have it autonomously execute and report back — directly matching the delegate-to-built-in-assistant story. First-party docs are extensive (docs-1, docs-2, docs-4, docs-7, docs-26) and community reports confirm developers actually build headless agent workflows on top of it (comm-6, comm-9), though some flag UX/observability gripes with the default harness rather than the delegation capability itself. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/hands-on evidence of task-completion quality/reliability at scale, and resolution of community concerns about harness polish which slightly tempers confidence in end-to-end experience.
